properties.name: C98906DF0BCF30C1
properties.text: In shadows, the journey commences. A hero emerges, guided by a cryptic letter. The identity of Sergeant Rolf remains veiled, as does the sender who concealed the message within the hero's belongings. The forsaken town of Nouraajd awaits, harboring mysteries for the hero to unravel.
